Name: ShopLite VM Operator
Description: Start, deallocate, and read the state of a VM. Nothing else: no delete, resize, run-command, disks, networking, or data access. Assigned on prod-sql-01 only, to the GitHub Actions managed identity (infra/github-oidc.md) and to the two Logic Apps' system-assigned identities (infra/vm-schedule-logic-apps.md).
